transcript: Speaker A (Tense): আমি টেন্স। পাস্ট, প্রেজেন্ট, ফিউচার আমি বলি কখন কি হয়েছে... [I am Tense. I explain past, present, and future. If your boss asks what you did yesterday and you say 'I am Go office', it is wrong. It should be 'I went to office'.] Speaker B (Article): আমি আর্টিকেল। A, An, The... [I am Article. People make many mistakes with me, like saying 'I am Engineer' instead of 'I am an Engineer'.] Speaker C (Preposition): আমি প্রিপজিশন... [I am Preposition. I show where and when things are. Say 'I am good at English', not 'I am good in English'.] Speaker D (Vocabulary): আমি ভোকাবুলারি... [I am Vocabulary. I help you speak smartly by replacing common words with better ones like 'Excellent' or 'Terrible'.] Speaker E (Pronunciation): আমি প্রোনাউন্সিয়েশন... [I am Pronunciation. I teach correct pronunciation, like saying 'Wenzday' instead of 'Wed-nes-day'.] Speaker F: ইংলিশ শিখো অ্যাপ ডাউনলোড করো... [Download the English Seekho app. Practice with an AI coach 24/7 without fear of judgment.]
on_screen_text: TENSE, PAST PRESENT FUTURE, What did you do on Yesterday?, I am Go office ভুল [Wrong], I went to Office ঠিক [Right], ARTICLE, A, AN, THE, I am Engineer ভুল, I am an Engineer ঠিক, PREPOSITIONS, IN, ON, AT, BY, FOR, VOCABULARY, PRONUNCIATION, English Seekho, Install Now
summary: Animated book characters representing Tense, Article, Preposition, Vocabulary, and Pronunciation explain common English mistakes made by Bengali speakers. They highlight how these errors can negatively impact professional opportunities and interviews. The ad concludes by promoting the English Seekho app as a judgment-free platform to practice and improve English skills with an AI coach.
